reason: Defines shared component patterns and accessibility expectations for the Markdown list editor.
Defines required type-check, test, lint, and manual verification.
The editor changes must preserve strict types and avoid new any assertions.
Desktop editor components use react-i18next, Zustand, and shared UI primitives.
Markdown output must stay consistent across preview and export template contexts.
Highlight Markdown flows through editor, store, preview, HTML, PDF, and DOCX.
